market_summary: Strong bearish trend expansion across FX pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD) and Gold (XAUUSD) during the London/NY Overlap, backed by strongly aligned negative CVD and breakdowns below Value Area Lows. US100 maintains high-level bullish structure near Session Highs inside VA but lacks clear expansion confirmation, while BTCUSD remains tightly bound around session POC/VWAP.

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (4039.33) and below POC (4044.58). CVD is BEARISH (-1.91) with negative slope (-0.37), agreeing with downside momentum. Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price is trading below VWAP (4047.83) and EMA50 (4048.52). Lower ATR band (4035.10) has been breached during the current breakdown, supported by moderate RVOL (1.386). Approaching Session Low support at 4026.41.

Price has aggressively broken below VAL (1.11309), POC (1.11371), and Session Low (1.11142). CVD is strongly BEARISH (-7,767) with a sharp negative slope (-6,503.51), fully confirming sell pressure. Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price is far below VWAP (1.11475) and EMA50 (1.11469). Price pushed beyond the lower ATR band (1.11239) with rising volume. Continuation down towards key lower handles expected.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish strongly below vwap and ema50

signals.rationale: Price is trading below VAL (1.33154) and POC (1.33476), breaking below Session Low support (1.32947). CVD is BEARISH (-4,207) with accelerating negative slope (-3,689.33). SESSION is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price is below VWAP (1.33266) and EMA50 (1.33276). Price has expanded through the lower ATR band (1.33020) with increasing RVOL (1.584), confirming persistent downside momentum.

Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 28065.40..VAH 28299.32) near VAH, and above POC (28115.52). CVD is BULLISH (+8.13) though slope has flattened slightly (-1.19). SESSION is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price remains securely above VWAP (28115.56) and EMA50 (28139.24). Price is near the upper ATR band (28323.33) and Session High (28310.45). Given tick volume caveats on US100 and price consolidating just inside VAH near resistance, holding for a clear breakout confirmation.

Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 73512.22..VAH 73907.38) and right at POC (73660.40). CVD is essentially flat / slightly BEARISH (-0.05) with zero momentum (slope -0.01). SESSION is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price is tightly hugging VWAP (73689.87) and EMA50 (73750.39) mid-channel between ATR bands with low RVOL (1.069). Ranging around fair value without clear directional catalyst suggests HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral oscillating around vwap and ema50
